name: Avillion Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有公布任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。包括资本削减、股份合并、供股及豁免申请，并已获Bursa Securities批准股份合并及供股。最新季度营收同比下降18.6%，全年营收从2025财年的58.48百万令吉降至55.18百万令吉。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts for its business segments. The main event was a group-level corporate restructuring proposal comprising capital reduction, share consolidation, rights issue, and exemption application, with Bursa Securities approving the share consolidation and rights issue. Latest quarterly revenue declined 18.6% year-on-year, and full-year revenue fell from MYR 58.48 million in FY2025 to MYR 55.18 million.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 包括资本削减、股份合并、供股及豁免申请。
segments.note_en: At the group level, corporate restructuring proposals were progressed this year, including capital reduction, share consolidation, rights issue, and exemption application.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities于2026年11月12日批准股份合并及最多283,257,620股合并股份（若未实施股份合并则最多2,832,576,200股供股股份）的上市和报价。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved on 12 November 2026 the share consolidation and the listing and quotation of up to 283,257,620 consolidated shares (or up to 2,832,576,200 rights shares if the share consolidation is not implemented).

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 就股份合并及供股向Bursa Securities提交申请，并就豁免相关通函草案向SC提交 clearance 申请。
actions.text_en: Submitted applications to Bursa Securities for the share consolidation and rights issue, and submitted the draft circular relating to the exemption to the SC for clearance.
